frames.source: DEX pool candles (GeckoTerminal public API), chosen by contract address

coverage.note: Not fully covered by the study. Coin: not covered. The study measured centralised-exchange (Binance) candles of 292 pairs; this coin's candles come from its DEX pool, which the study did not measure. The same rates are applied. Daily: the timeframe the rates were measured on. Held-out: higher scores were NOT followed by rises more often.

frames.midpoint: 50 = the base rate: the share of all study candles that were followed by a rise 10 candles later. Above 50, the patterns on the chart rose more often than that in the study; below 50, less often.
frames.reading: Neutral: Bullish engulfing after a drop, Lower highs and lower lows.

50.meaning: 50 = the base rate: the share of all study candles that were followed by a rise 10 candles later. Above 50, the patterns on the chart rose more often than that in the study; below 50, less often.

frames.rule: The score is the average success rate of the distinct patterns confirmed in the last 10 candles (a pattern type confirmed more than once counts once, at its most recent confirmation, and only that one is marked counted_in_score), placed on a scale where the most bearish pattern is 1, the base rate (share of all study candles that rose) is 50 and the most bullish pattern is 100. With no pattern, the score is 50.
frames.not_advice: A probability from history, never a promise. A measured statistic, not financial advice and not a forecast. It places no orders.
frames.forming_note: The last candle is still open, so the number can change until it closes.

verdict.label: NO EDGE
verdict.why: The study measured exchange candles; this asset's candles come from a DEX pool or your own file, which it did not measure, so no verdict is given for it: NO EDGE by rule. The table's figures for a chart like this one are shown under up / down for reference only.

target.text: a rise of 10% before a fall of 10% within 30 1d candles (on closes)

verdict.rule: A label needs the calibrated probability at least 5 points over the base rate, with its 95% range (over the pooled calibration cases it was made from) above the base rate and the raw bin's own 95% range above it too, on at least 300 cases in that bin, and that label's record on the held-out years must have beaten the base rate; otherwise NO EDGE. The study measured exchange candles, so a DEX-pool coin or an uploaded series gets no label. A probability from history, never a promise.

withheld.reason: asset_not_covered: DEX pool candles were not measured by the study

verdict.coverage_note: This asset's candles were not in the study (it measured exchange candles; these come from a DEX pool), so no verdict is given for it. The table's figures under up / down are the study's, not this asset's own.

weekly_signal.rule: weekly RSI(14) below 40 AND weekly MACD(12,26,9) histogram rising versus the prior week

record.target: a weekly close at least +3% above the signal week's close within the next 13 weekly closes
record.pooled_note: All assets counted together, the right kind of evidence; one asset's own record is not shown here: 200 of the 475 assets of that study have fewer than 10 signals.

weekly_signal.note: Needs at least 42 completed weeks of candles and a timeframe of one week or shorter.

projections.basis: Calibrated P(first barrier) for this chart's active setups from the expert study (train years -> weights, 2021-2022 -> calibration, held-out years -> proof); 'sideways' is the remainder: neither barrier inside the window. Paths are straight lines to the barrier at the end of the window; the study measured first-barrier hits, not the route. A probability from history, never a promise.
projections.reason: asset_not_covered: DEX pool candles were not measured by the study

frames.rule: Up = the close is above a rising 20-candle EMA (higher than 3 candles earlier); down = below a falling one; anything else is sideways.
